Mary-Agnes Wilson concluded her nine-month tenure as Interim President and CEO, having previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Nursing Executive. Her leadership was instrumental in opening Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital during the pandemic and launching multiple innovative programs including the Long Stay Unit, Behavioural Acute Care for Elders unit, and Hospital at Home program.

Carmine Stumpo, a pharmacist by training and seasoned health care leader, began his role as President and CEO after previously serving as President and CEO of Orillia Soldiers' Memorial Hospital (OSMH). At OSMH, he led major transformational initiatives including securing approval for a new hospital, expanding surgical services, and establishing a family medicine teaching unit. He stepped down from OSMH on April 2, 2026 to assume this position.
